Why Average Income is Not Enough: two countries, same average of 10,000, very different lives. Class 10 Economics, Development.

• Average (per capita) income is total income divided by total population
• Country A: everyone earns close to 10,000, average 10,000
• Country B: four earn 500, one earns 48,000, average still 10,000
• Averages hide how income is distributed, so they are not a complete measure of development
